title.en: China’s next decade to cement status as hi-tech manufacturing powerhouse: reports
title.zh: 报告称：中国未来十年将巩固其高科技制造业强国的地位
title.es: La próxima década de China consolidará su estatus como potencia manufacturera de alta tecnología: informes

items.source: China Economy - South China Morning Post

facts.en:
- China is expected to solidify its position as a hi-tech manufacturing powerhouse over the next decade as it edges closer to “innovation and excellence” alongside the United States, Germany and Japan, according to new reports issued by Chinese institutions.
The documents, published on Tuesday, stated that China had achieved its “strategic goal” of becoming the world’s fourth-most-advanced “manufacturing power” in 2024, adding that the sector would play a central role in “real” economic...
- MiniMax, a Chinese artificial intelligence startup, launched its initial public offering in Hong Kong on Wednesday, aiming to raise as much as HK$4.2 billion ($540 million) in a critical test of investor appetite for the capital-hungry sector.... Read more
- The Chinese yuan closed out 2025 with its strongest performance in over two years, breaching the key 7-per-dollar threshold and logging a 4.2% annual gain — its first in four years.... Read more
facts.zh:
- 根据中国机构发布的最新报告，预计未来十年中国将巩固其作为高科技制造业强国的地位，在“创新与卓越”方面与美国、德国和日本日益接近。
这些于周二发布的文件指出，中国已在2024年实现成为全球第四大“制造业强国”的“战略目标”，并补充称该行业将在“实体”经济中发挥核心作用...
- 中国人工智能初创企业MiniMax于周三在香港启动首次公开募股，计划筹集高达42亿港元（5.4亿美元），这是对资本密集型行业投资者兴趣的关键考验。
... 阅读更多
- 人民币在2025年收官时创下两年多来最强表现，突破关键的7元兑1美元关口，全年上涨4.2%——这是四年来的首次年度上涨。
... 阅读更多
facts.es:
- Se espera que China consolide su posición como potencia manufacturera de alta tecnología durante la próxima década, acercándose a la "innovación y excelencia" junto con Estados Unidos, Alemania y Japón, según nuevos informes emitidos por instituciones chinas.
Los documentos, publicados el martes, afirmaron que China había logrado su "objetivo estratégico" de convertirse en la cuarta "potencia manufacturera" más avanzada del mundo en 2024, añadiendo que el sector desempeñaría un papel central en la economía "real"...
- MiniMax, una startup china de inteligencia artificial, lanzó su oferta pública inicial en Hong Kong el miércoles, con el objetivo de recaudar hasta HK$4.200 millones ($540 millones) en una prueba crucial del apetito de los inversores por el sector intensivo en capital.

facts.en:
- Digital finance has moved into the mainstream as regulated stablecoins and tokenised assets scale up, but industry experts say 2026 will be defined by success in developing interoperable, regulated, use-case-driven rails rather than more digital silos.
As more than 130 jurisdictions explore central bank digital currencies (CBDCs), alongside dozens of stablecoin initiatives and a growing array of tokenisation platforms, day-to-day payments and finance are undergoing a rapid structural...

title.en: Mystery trader makes $526,000 windfall betting on Maduro's ouster
title.zh: 神秘交易员押注马杜罗下台，意外获利52.6万美元
title.es: Misterioso trader obtiene ganancia inesperada de $526,000 apostando por la salida de Maduro

facts.en:
- Unknown trader made bets amounting to US$34,000 in days leading up to Maduro’s capture.
- The Nasdaq gained 0.69 per cent, while the Dow rose 1.23 per cent to 48,977.18 points.
- "China and Pakistan will further promote their ironclad ties, deepen mutually beneficial cooperation, and continue to strengthen their strategic cooperation to break new ground," said a joint statement from both countries.
facts.zh:
- 一名身份不明的交易员在马杜罗被捕前的几天内进行了总额为34,000美元的押注。
- 纳斯达克指数上涨0.69%，而道琼斯指数上涨1.23%，收于48,977.18点。
- 中巴两国联合声明表示：“中国和巴基斯坦将进一步推动两国铁杆友谊，深化互利合作，并继续加强战略合作，开拓新局面。”
facts.es:
- Un comerciante desconocido realizó apuestas por un monto de US$34,000 en los días previos a la captura de Maduro.
- El Nasdaq ganó un 0.69 por ciento, mientras que el Dow subió un 1.23 por ciento a 48,977.18 puntos.
- "China y Pakistán promoverán aún más sus lazos inquebrantables, profundizarán la cooperación mutuamente beneficiosa y continuarán fortaleciendo su cooperación estratégica para abrir nuevos horizontes", dijo una declaración conjunta de ambos países.

title.en: As Tesla’s stock falls, Elon Musk brushes off Nvidia’s competitive threat
title.zh: 随着特斯拉股价下跌，埃隆·马斯克对英伟达的竞争威胁不屑一顾
title.es: A medida que cae la acción de Tesla, Elon Musk ignora la amenaza competitiva de Nvidia.

facts.en:
- Nvidia is ramping up its work on driverless vehicle technology, a field dominated by Tesla and a few other players. But Musk doesn’t see an imminent reason to worry.
- Memory and storage stocks reigned supreme in 2025 and are leading the pack once again to start 2026.

- 内存和存储类股票在2025年表现卓越，并在2026年初再次领跑市场。
- “我已退休，我的妻子是一名在职医生。她今年56岁，也希望能退休。”
facts.es:
